body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Philips launched its fitness MP3 player 'Activa' during Digital Experience at CES 2010.

Activa is a portable audio player designer to help motivate people to work out more frequently and intensely. It provides stimulating real-time feedback on a workout performance and works seamlessly with a person's music library via Philips Songbird.

A proprietary new technology from Philips called TempoMusic automatically synchronizes music to work out pace and acts like a trainer. Activa plays more intense, fast-tempo songs as the user's activity rate increases.
